[![Go Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/MarkRosemaker/oauth2local.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/MarkRosemaker/oauth2local) ![Code Coverage](https://img.shields.io/badge/coverage-12%25-red) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Gets an OAuth 2.0 token for a command-line program through the user's browser. `GetToken` starts a server on `localhost:8080`, opens `/auth`, which redirects to the provider's consent page, and exchanges the code the provider sends back to `/callback` (register `http://localhost:8080/callback` as a redirect URL). With a service name, the token is cached under the system temp directory, one file per set of scopes, and refreshed when it expires. `GetClient` returns an `*http.Client` that uses that token.
